title: Emmre's Full Offline Agents and Automation Skill Catalog
source: Emmre's Full Offline Agents and Automation Skill Catalog (24 categories, 288 skills)
design_principles: No internet dependency during normal operation.
Every external package, model, dataset, and update enters through a controlled and verifiable import path.
Least privilege, explicit approvals, provenance, local audit, and bounded resources apply to all agents and tools.
Passing behavior must be reproducible from a clean state and recoverable after interruption.
Human operators retain clear visibility, correction, cancellation, rollback, and emergency-stop controls.

Appendix: Recommended Executable Skill Contract When a catalog entry becomes an executable skill, define the following contract so it can be tested, governed, repaired, and reused offline. Field Definition Purpose Exact outcome and non-goals. Triggers Requests, events, schedules, files, or state changes that activate it. Inputs Types, schemas, limits, classifications, and prerequisites. Outputs Artifacts, state changes, evidence, and failure forms. Local Dependencies Models, packages, runtimes, datasets, devices, and operating-system features. Permissions Files, tools, data, identities, secrets, devices, and network scopes. Resource Budgets CPU, RAM, VRAM, disk, time, concurrency, and queue limits. Procedure Ordered checkpoints, joins, retries, approvals, and stop conditions. Validation Schema, meaning, security, presentation, performance, and clean-state checks. Recovery Checkpoint, rollback, compensation, replay, and operator handoff. Audit and Provenance Events, sources, versions, decisions, approvals, and artifact lineage. Test Fixtures Normal, boundary, adversarial, failure, recovery, and regression cases. Versioning Compatibility, migrations, deprecation, and rollback rules.
